  301      """Streamable-HTTP MCP session: initialize -> initialized -> tools/call over keep-alive."""
  302  
  303      def __init__(self, url: str):
  304          self.url = url
  305          self.host, self.port_path = url[len("http://") :].split("/", 1)
  306          self.path = "/" + self.port_path
  307          self.conn: HTTPConnection | None = None
  308          self.session_id: str | None = None
  309          self._id = 0
  310  
  311      def _post(self, payload: dict) -> tuple[dict, object]:
  312          if self.conn is None:
  313              self.conn = HTTPConnection(self.host, timeout=HTTP_TIMEOUT_S)
  314          headers = {
  315              "Content-Type": "application/json",
  316              "Accept": "application/json, text/event-stream",
  317          }
  318          if self.session_id:
  319              headers["mcp-session-id"] = self.session_id
  320          body = json.dumps(payload)
  321          self.conn.request("POST", self.path, body=body, headers=headers)
  322          resp = self.conn.getresponse()
  323          raw = resp.read().decode()
  324          messages = self._parse_messages(raw)
  325          return messages, resp
  326  
  327      @staticmethod
  328      def _parse_messages(raw: str) -> list[dict]:
  329          raw = raw.strip()
  330          if raw.startswith("{"):
  331              return [json.loads(raw)]
  332          return [
  333              json.loads(line[len("data:") :].strip())
  334              for line in raw.splitlines()
  335              if line.startswith("data:")
  336          ]
  337  
  338      def _reconnect(self) -> None:
  339          if self.conn is not None:
  340              try:
  341                  self.conn.close()
  342              except OSError:
  343                  pass
  344          self.conn = None
  345  
  346      def _rpc(self, payload: dict) -> list[dict]:
  347          for attempt in (1, 2):
  348              try:
  349                  messages, _resp = self._post(payload)
  350                  return messages
  351              except (OSError, http.client.HTTPException):
  352                  if attempt == 2:
  353                      raise
  354                  self._reconnect()
  355          raise OSError("unreachable")

  360          messages, resp = self._post(
  361              {
  362                  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  363                  "id": 1,
  364                  "method": "initialize",
  365                  "params": {
  366                      "protocolVersion": PROTOCOL_VERSION,
  367                      "capabilities": {},
  368                      "clientInfo": {"name": "rust-migration-baseline", "version": "0"},
  369                  },
  370              }
  371          )

  373          if not self.session_id:
  374              raise RuntimeError("initialize carried no mcp-session-id")
  375          self._rpc({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "notifications/initialized"})
  376          listing = self._rpc({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 2, "method": "tools/list"})
  377          return [t["name"] for t in listing[0]["result"]["tools"]]

  379      def call(self, tool: str, args: dict) -> tuple[bool, str]:
  380          """One tools/call; returns (is_error, first_content_text_snippet)."""
  381          self._id += 1
  382          payload = {
  383              "jsonrpc": "2.0",

  119      def __init__(self, description: str, total: Optional[int], unit: str):
  120          self.tasks = [_SimpleTask(description, total, unit)]
  121          self._cg_task_id = 0

  127      def update(self, task_id: int, *, completed: Optional[int] = None,
  128                 total: Optional[int] = None, description: Optional[str] = None,
  129                 advance: Optional[int] = None) -> None:
  130          task = self.tasks[task_id]
  131          # Only treat description as a "force" draw if it actually changed.
  132          desc_changed = False
  133          if description is not None and description != task.description:
  134              task.description = description
  135              desc_changed = True
  136          if total is not None:
  137              task.total = total
  138          if completed is not None:
  139              task.completed = completed
  140          if advance is not None:
  141              task.completed += advance
  142          self._maybe_draw(force=desc_changed)

  144      def advance(self, amount: int = 1) -> None:
  145          self.update(self._cg_task_id, advance=amount)
  146

  150      def set_description(self, desc: str) -> None:

  153      def _maybe_draw(self, force: bool = False) -> None:
  154          task = self.tasks[self._cg_task_id]
  155  
  156          # Time-based throttle is the PRIMARY gate: never draw more than once
  157          # per <DUR>. Description changes bypass it (so phase transitions are
  158          # visible immediately) but only if ><DUR> has passed.
  159          now = time.time()
  160          elapsed_since_draw = now - self._last_draw
  161          desc_changed = task.description != self._last_desc
  162  
  163          should_draw = (
  164              force
  165              or elapsed_since_draw >= 0.5
  166              or (desc_changed and elapsed_since_draw >= 0.2)
  167          )
  168          if not should_draw:
  169              return
  170  
  171          self._last_desc = task.description
  172          self._last_draw = now
  173

  175          elapsed = now - self._t0
  176          if task.total:
  177              pct = int(100 * task.completed / task.total)

  181              unit_str = f" {task.unit}" if task.unit else ""

  185              )
